title: Electra
description: A visceral new staging of Sophocles' tragedy, set in a crumbling Glasgow tenement. Directed by Dominic Hill, this reimagining strips the myth to its raw emotional core — rage, grief, and the cost of revenge.

title: Salt
description: A searing debut from Glasgow playwright Rae Morrison about three generations of women on the Ayrshire coast. Grief, resilience, and the tidal pull of home — sharp and deeply felt.

title: Body of Work
description: Award-winning choreographer Janice Parker returns with a mesmerising solo exploring ageing, memory, and the stories our bodies carry. A Tramway commission in the vast space of T1.

title: The Chippers
description: A Play, A Pie and A Pint. A hilarious new comedy about two rival chip shop owners on the same Partick street. When a food critic turns up unannounced, all bets are off. Lunch included.

title: Night Shift
description: A Play, A Pie and A Pint. Two nurses on the night shift at the Royal find their friendship tested when a controversial patient arrives. A taut two-hander about care, conscience, and what we owe each other.

title: Bingo Wings
description: A Play, A Pie and A Pint. Three regulars at a Maryhill bingo hall discover their beloved club is closing. Their plan to save it is ambitious, absurd, and surprisingly moving. A warm comedy with heart.

title: Glad Scratch Night #14
description: Four emerging artists share 15-minute works-in-progress in a supportive Southside setting. This edition features new pieces exploring identity, migration, and belonging. BYOB.

title: Futures Festival
description: A weekend festival showcasing work by Glasgow's young theatre-makers aged 16-25. Performances, workshops, and panel discussions across three days in Easterhouse.

title: Yerma
description: Lorca's devastating portrait of desire and societal expectation in a bold new translation by Jo Clifford. Staged in the Citz's newly restored main auditorium — unmissable.

title: Tron Scratch Series: Spring
description: Three Scottish companies present 20-minute extracts of ambitious new work. This edition features pieces exploring queer joy, urban rewilding, and what it means to belong somewhere.

title: Mother Tongues
description: A multilingual devised performance created with Glasgow's refugee and immigrant communities. Stories of language, loss, and new beginnings woven together in Tramway's T2 studio.

title: NOISE: A Performance Evening
description: An evening of experimental performance and sound art in Glasgow's beloved Renfield Lane basement. Four artists blur the lines between theatre, music, and visual art. Pay what you can.

title: Matilda The Musical
description: The RSC's multi-award-winning musical returns to Glasgow. Roald Dahl's beloved story of a little girl with extraordinary powers and an even more extraordinary imagination. Matinees available.

title: The Spontaneous Players
description: Glasgow's longest-running improv troupe takes the stage at Cottiers for a night of completely unscripted comedy. Every show is different — audience suggestions drive the chaos.

title: Verse / Versus
description: A spoken word and performance poetry night in the back room at Mono. Six poets, three rounds, one winner — decided by the audience. Plus open mic slots. Free entry.
